title: Evaluation of dynamic corneal response parameters and the biomechanical E-staging after Intacs® SK implantation in keratoconus

groups.description: 49 keratoconic corneas of 41 contact-lens-intolerant adult patients (Results: older than 18 years; Methods: adult patients >= 18 years) treated with femtosecond-laser-assisted Intacs SK intracorneal ring segment implantation (2017-2021), one surgeon; no prior or simultaneous cross-linking; inclusion required TCT > 450 µm and Kmax < 65 D.

series.baseline_label: Kmax 'Preoperatively' column of block A (35 corneas of 28 patients), Table 1
series.notes: mean±SD as printed; unit dioptres from the Methods (inclusion criterion Kmax < 65 D) and the Abstract; Pentacam (Oculus). Block A pairs the preoperative and 3-month values of the 35 corneas measured at 3 months (actual interval 2.8 ± 0.7 months, Results).

exclusions.what: P column of each Kmax row (IJO.IJO_2944_23-T1!R3C7, R19C7, R35C7)
exclusions.reason: p-values are not admissible values (protocol inclusion 4)
anterior radius of curvature (the 'A' parameter of the ABCD classification), not Kmax (protocol inclusion 1)

notes: Table 1 reports three paired blocks (A, B, C), each comparing the preoperative values with one follow-up for the corneas measured at that follow-up; the blocks overlap in eyes (35, 33 and 29 of the 49 corneas) and each block carries its own preoperative Kmax, so each block is extracted as its own two-point series with its own same-eye baseline; the eyes of the three series are not independent.

Missing follow-ups are ordinary attrition (measurements available for 35, 33 and 29 of 49 corneas; inclusion required Pentacam and Corvis ST examinations of quality 'OK' before and after surgery, a data-quality criterion, not an outcome-defined selection).
Visit times are the nominal times stated in the Table 1 headers and footnote (3, 6 and 11 months); preoperative measurements were taken 1.9 ± 1.1 months before surgery (Results).
Other tabulated parameters (TCT, BAD-D, ARTh, SP-A1, IR, DA ratio 2 mm, A1 velocity, SSI, CBiF, E-staging) are not used.
